location: Dusit Beach Resort Guam in Tumon
title: Please be advised that Legislative Certificate No. 453-38 (COR) is scheduled to be presented to the WestCare Pacific Islands at 2:30 PM on Saturday, September 26, 2026, at the Dusit Beach Resort Guam in Tumon “for the commitment to amplifying youth voices and dedication to empowering youth, and promoting community-driven solutions through the Guahan Youth Initiative at the Second Annual Youth Conference held on September 26, 2026, at the Dusit Beach Resort Guam.” 09/24/26 10:30 AM (FN)
